datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule across Kenya in 2015. The spatial data represents acute food insecurity phases classified according to the IPC standard, with geographic boundaries and severity classifications aggregated by collection period and scenario.
